title: Rhodes Island Central Kitchen - New Year's Gourmet Feast Collection
lines: Dear Doctors, thanks for your support this year! Arknights Official Manga, Rhodes Kitchen - Tidbits, has been released on the official website ( https://www.arknights.global/comic ), and we hope you will enjoy it! As the New Year draws near, Central Kitchen has been working hard to prepare the New Year's feast with a wide variety of dishes, which will include 5 Courses: Appetizer, Soup, Main Course, Dessert, and Drink. Operators on Rhodes Island are from all over the Terra with different tastes, and they are salivating for new dishes. What kind of cuisine will stand out from the competition and win the hearts of this diverse group of gourmets? Doctors, time for you to shine!

During the event, you can choose at least one of the 5 Courses: Appetizer, Soup, Main Course, Dessert, and Drink based on your preference, then prepare a dish in the style of "Realism" or "Idealism". Afterward, post a photo or picture of your dish according to the official recipe template on social media for this event.

Invited Judges from Rhodes Island will select one Realism and one Idealism dish from each of the 5 Courses, for a total of 10 dishes as the winning entries. Doctors who make the corresponding dish will also receive the title of New Year's Culinarian and rewards for it!
* This event covers Arknights' EN and KR servers, and the winning entries will be chosen from the participants on one of the two servers.
DURATION: December 18, 2022, 20:00 (UTC-7) - January 1, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
STYLES:

Realism - Choose real-life ingredients, prepare one of the 5 Courses you want to make, and take a photo of the completed dish. Then, post it using the official recipe template, and don't forget to include a recipe description or cooking tips!

Idealism - Draw a picture of the course you want to make in one of the 5 Courses, with no restrictions on theme, ingredients, or art style. Then, post it using the official recipe template, and don't forget to include a description of the inspiration or recipe!
Recipe Template (Choose one of two types to participate in the event):
a. Use the official JPG converter ( https://menudesign.arknights.global/ ). Post your dish by filling in your nickname and dish name, and attaching a photo with a text description in the template.
b. Download the official picture template ( https:// bit.ly/3PbIyab ). Create a recipe for the dish you want to make according to the template and post your finished work.
How To Participate:
1. Follow Arknights Official on: Twitter, @ArknightsEN ; Facebook, @ArknightsGlobal ; Instagram, arknights_messager_official .
2. Upload your work on Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram with #RhodesKitchen+#Arknights+#Tidbits .
3. Go to https://forms.gle/dPMxzH8p7eaeTJUm6 to fill in the link to the SNS post of the work, the account info on that SNS platform, the in-game UID and the e-mail address.

4. Finish the 3 steps above and you are a participant! Invited Judges from Rhodes Island will select one Realism and one Idealism dish from each of the 5 Courses, and 20 Doctors will receive the title of New Year's Culinarian and rewards for it!
Invited Judges Showcase:
Let's introduce the Invited Judges for this event, who will comment on the winners' dishes. Wonder what they will say about those dishes from the Doctors.
Rewards Overview:
New Year's Culinarian Rewards:
*Five entries each from EN and KR servers will be selected and awarded. Food-Themed Plushie Set * 1, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 4, LMD * 150000, and Headhunting Permit * 3
PS: The winning entries will likely be featured in the subsequent chapter of Rhodes Kitchen - Tidbits.
To show our appreciation for all participating Doctors, additional awards have been prepared:
Event Rules:
1. You can post multiple dishes, but only one can be selected as the winning entry, as judges will only consider the entry with the highest overall quality as the winning one.
2. Photos or drawings of food that have been publicly posted before the event begins cannot be used as entries.

3. All entries must not contain political, violent, sexual, grotesque, or other content that is restricted by the platform, involve infringement by others, or violate the relevant rules. Any violation of these rules may result in disqualification from the award.
4. Entries with the obvious commercial promotion are not eligible to win.
NOTE:
1. The photos, drawings, and recipes posted as entries may be used and published by Yostar Games.
2. Please protect your privacy in the photos you post.
3. Collaboration entries should be posted by one account.

4. Winners will receive an email after the results are announced. If the winner does not reply to the email with the required details within 5 business days of receiving it, their reward will be deemed forfeited for claiming. (Only winners will receive the email.)
5. Please do not delete your submitted posts with hashtags during the event, otherwise you will be disqualified from winning in the final review.
6. Winners cannot transfer their qualifications to others. Once found, they will be disqualified.
7. We will not be responsible for any failure in sending physical rewards due to rejection by the winner during the process of sending rewards.
8. Please double-check your info is correct before submitting it. We will not be responsible for the issuance of rewards due to incorrect info provided by the participants themselves.
If you have any questions about this event or have found any violations, please contact us at arknights.event@yo-star.com.
Be aware that this email is exclusively for receiving feedback provided by participants from the EN server. For participants on the KR server, please provide feedback to the KR server contact email.
Yostar Games Operations Team reserves the right of final interpretation of this event.
